overview_description.description: AI21 Labs is a creator of generative artificial intelligence and massive language models, as well as tools for creating artificial intelligence systems with extraordinary understanding and generation of natural language. The company's tool captures real intelligence and rewrites writing to say exactly what is meant; it transforms the way people read and write, empowering them in the process; it is an artificial intelligence-based writing companion that understands context and meaning; and it helps people read more efficiently by providing summaries, allowing customers to understand, analyze, and visualize abstract knowledge structures.

about_short_description.short_description: AI21 Labs develops AI systems designed to understand and generate natural language with high accuracy.

product.name: Jamba 1.6 Models
product.description: A family of open large language models designed for enterprise deployment, supporting long context tasks with efficient inference and customizable deployment options.

product.name: AI21 Studio
product.description: A production-grade SaaS platform providing access to AI21 Labs’ language models and pre-configured workflows for enterprise AI projects.

product.name: Flexible Deployment Options
product.description: Various deployment methods including SaaS, AI21-managed private deployments, partner-hosted, and self-managed private deployments to meet enterprise data security and compliance needs.

product.name: Conversational RAG
product.description: A retrieval-augmented generation system that adds a conversational AI layer to applications by grounding responses in relevant organizational data.

product.name: AI21 Maestro
product.description: An AI planning and orchestration system that dynamically creates, executes, and validates complex multi-step AI workflows for enterprise use.

product.name: Contextual Answers Model
product.description: A task-specific language model designed to provide accurate, cited answers grounded in an organization’s data for enterprise applications.
